en: Black‑and‑white postcard view over a small town surrounded by wooded hills. In the foreground are open fields, a two‑storey rectangular building with a flagpole, a smaller outbuilding, and a road with an early automobile near a small kiosk or bus stop. In the middle distance are clustered wooden houses among many trees, and further back larger institutional buildings on the hillside. The sky is lightly clouded. The lower left corner bears the town name "LJUNGSKILE", and the lower right corner has a printer's mark and the text "Ensamtätt: C. A. Tref, Göteborg."
